title: WorkerCapabilities
description: What a worker safely advertises when it registers. Deliberately minimal and non-revealing: no filesystem paths, no home directory, no environment variables, no project locations, no secrets. additionalProperties:false is what enforces that — a field like blend_root or api_key cannot be added by accident.

worker_version.description: Version of the worker software, not of the host machine.

blender_version.description: Reported only when Blender is available.

gpu_name.description: Coarse device description for scheduling, e.g. 'NVIDIA RTX 4070 Ti'.

supported_job_types.description: The operations this worker will accept. A job outside this list is rejected.
